items.label: GARDEN NETTING KIT FOR RAISED BEDS
items.value: Our garden netting kit includes a high-quality 10’ x 20’ insect barrier net, 8 sturdy metal garden netting support stakes, and 16 rust-proof stainless steel clips. This durable combination creates a reliable protective barrier, perfect for keeping pests out of gardens, orchards, vegetable patches, and raised beds to safeguard your fruits and veggies

items.label: EXCEPTIONAL STABILITY & DURABILITY
items.value: Our heavy-duty black heavy duty garden stake netting supports are crafted from thick-walled steel tubing that resists bending or breaking. Featuring a rust-resistant coating for superior corrosion protection, each stake has a 3.75-inch (9.5 cm) ground-penetrating tip. This design ensures they stay firmly fixed in place, providing reliable plant netting support even during high winds and heavy rain. The threaded connection system offers excellent self-locking strength and rigidity—far more durable and stable than plastic connectors.

items.label: TEAR-RESISTANT ULTRA-FINE MESH GARDEN PEST BARRIER
items.value: Crafted from premium high-density PE, this vegetable garden insect proof net delivers exceptional durability. Its featuring enhanced thickness and UV resistance. The densely woven structure (0.8mm x 1mm micro-mesh) ensures superior tensile strength and tear resistance, providing reliable protection without stressing plants.Blocks birds, squirrels, rabbits, deer, insects, and other pests while maintaining outstanding breathability. Optimized airflow, efficient water penetration, and >90% sunlight transmission create an ideal microclimate for healthy plant growth.

items.label: EFFORTLESS ASSEMBLY
items.value: This garden support stake set features 2 compact rods. Simply twist the sections together to create extended metal stakes, insert them into soil, drape your netting, and secure with included clips. With minimal components and no-tool assembly, it eliminates complicated multi-step installations. Just weigh down the edges with stones or soil to create optimal growing conditions for your vegetables, flowers, and fruit trees.

items.label: VEGETABLE AND FRUIT BARRIER PROTECTION
items.value: This garden netting with support hoops creates an ideal environment for seedling germination and growth while providing full coverage protection for mature fruits, blueberry bushes, fig trees, strawberries, and vegetables. Effectively blocks rabbits, squirrels, birds, poultry, flying insects, and other pests to maximize seasonal harvests. Widely used in orchards, gardens, vegetable patches, greenhouses, and pastures. Serves as an insect net, bird net, animal barrier, and garden fence, fully safeguarding your plants.
